capabilities: Sync vault files across devices through WebDAV, S3-compatible storage, or Baidu Netdisk
Preview planned uploads, downloads, conflicts and skips before running a sync
Save conflicting edits as copies and keep local backups of replaced content
Exclude folders, paths or file extensions from upload and download
Review recent sync results and restore backups or conflict copies as new files
extras: Interface is currently in Chinese. Credentials are stored unencrypted in data.json; there is no end-to-end encryption, deletions and renames are not propagated, and real-account and mobile device testing was still pending at publication.
problem: Obsidian has no core way to sync a vault through a user-configured WebDAV server, S3-compatible bucket, or Baidu Netdisk account instead of the built-in Sync service.

relations.evidence: 适用于标准 WebDAV 服务，如坚果云、Nextcloud、NAS
使用 AWS SigV4 和 ListObjectsV2；可配置 AWS S3、R2、MinIO 等兼容接口
实现文件列表、预上传、4 MB 分片、创建文件、获取下载链接

requires.name: WebDAV server, S3-compatible storage, or Baidu Netdisk account
S3 access/secret keys or Baidu Netdisk access_token
storage provider fees for storage, requests or bandwidth

summary: Sync plugin that keeps vault notes in sync across devices via WebDAV, S3-compatible storage, or Baidu Netdisk, with conflict copies and local backups.
